notes: Starting (10) as posted: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe, Epic Duel, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Watto's Box, Visage Of The Emperor; these count toward the 60.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the deck runs Coruscant-set cards (They Will Be No Match For You, The Phantom Menace, Maul Strikes) and the strategy calls them the new Coruscant effects.
Visage Of The Emperor is posted once in Starting and x2 under Effects; 3 total, kept as published.

Posted 'Hunt Down/Fire Gone out of universe' dested the Objective; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'U-3P0' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Start Yout Engines' Start Your Engines!; 'Unexspected Interruption' Unexpected Interruption; 'Ommni Box/It`s Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.
Tatooine: Podrace Arena and Boonta Eve Podrace dested to their Dark pages; Secret Plans is the Dark Special Edition Effect (posted under Effects).

Byline 'Christopher "chris"99"man" Seymour' credited to the existing Chris Seymour page (DeckTech handle vader69 on his later posts), who posted a near-identical Hunt Down podracing list in September 2001 (DeckTech 18851).
